type.description: fact, rumor, situation, name, tip, promise, check, followup, state, reflection, or your own word; never sheet, since a person's sheet is rendered from their facts.

text.description: One fact in one short sentence, in English whatever language the room speaks.

type.description: What it is: person, room, document, ...

key.description: Its key as you know it: a person's id, a room's id.

source.description: own: the person about themselves; owner: the owner's word; told: someone about someone else; inferred: your conclusion.

confirms.description: Ids of live memories this merely repeats.

strengthens.description: The id of the live memory this says more fully.

replaces.description: Ids of live memories this contradicts.

grounds.description: Ids of the episodes this rests on.

key.description: Your own identifier, for a memory you may rewrite later.

room.description: The room's id to link as a subject; this turn's room where none is given; empty to link no room, as for a fact about a person that holds wherever they are.

validFrom.description: When it began holding, where that was before now: a date (YYYY-MM-DD) or an RFC 3339 time, such as the moment of the archived message it was read in; now where none is given.
